title: Hugo de Moncada to Charles V, Monaco, 6 October 1524 (BNE MSS/20213/12, DECODE R1191)

steps.what: BNE Digital viewer blocked by a Cloudflare challenge (browser pane and curl); IIIF paths 403.
DECODE dump searched for 1524 BNE records: R1191 'NLS_MSS_20213_12' (no author) is the letter; two images fetched with the cookie.
Pencil margin note read as 'Descifrada en t.o 24 Col. Doc. inéd.'; CODOIN XXIV found on the Internet Archive (bub_gb_VGwxkA0412wC): the letter printed pp. 417-419 with the cipher deciphered, one gap.
Cipher runs transcribed from the DECODE image, deskewed -2.7 deg, cropped 3-8x: 442 signs in 17 runs (ct.txt).
Soria 1523 keys A and B (Genoa, same court) compared: three-letter code groups, a different system.
EM alignment of each run against the printed plaintext (em_align.py; sign emits 0-2 letters, letters may be skipped, printed gap free) gave the homophonic key; finished by hand in KEY.md.
Print checked against the cipher run by run (tienen pan, si el duque de Genoua querra dexar yr las galeras, que fuese fuerte, largamente sobre esto, muy mal contento, de la Mota): agreement.
Print's gap read with the rebuilt key at 6-8x: 'a España' (4 8 s w A n~ r) and 'diziendome' (f# 3 S# z# L p # H b L); 99 and three code groups left open.

outcome.fraction_read_source: moncada1524/ct.txt against reading.txt, cipher tokens: 428 of 442 given a value; open = code groups =D., P#D, =P#D.f (12 signs) and 99 (2 signs)

gaps.detail: each occurs once, no key; the print gives no counterpart except 'duque' for the first

gaps.item: 99 at the end of cipher line 2 (2 signs)
gaps.detail: set apart at the margin; 'a a' or line-end nulls

outcome.notes: The 1854 print (from the secretariat's decipherment) agrees with the cipher wherever checked; the key rebuilt from it reads the print's gap: 'que le lleuase a España, [99] diziendome muchas razones para ello'.

prior.where: CODOIN XXIV (Madrid 1854) pp. 417-419, with a gap ('me rogaba que le llevase .... muchas razones'); Tomokiyo (spanish2C, June 2026) had not found it

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login and passed its session cookie to the model, and posed the problem with /goal from the catalogue entry. No target-specific intervention recorded.
